name: JotNexus
tagline: 400+ free utilities for PDFs, media, converters, and everyday work.
description: JotNexus is the complete online utility hub — 400+ tools for documents, images, video, audio, unit conversion, developers, and more. No accounts. Upload files when a tool needs them; processing runs in your browser and your data never leaves your device.

categoryPages.title: Free PDF Tools Online — Merge, Split, Compress & Convert
categoryPages.description: Free online PDF tools — merge, split, compress, rotate, convert to images, and more. Upload your PDF; everything runs locally in your browser. No signup.
categoryPages.intro: Every PDF tool on this page runs in your browser. Upload a file, get results instantly, and download — your documents never leave your device.

categoryPages.title: Free Image Tools Online — Resize, Compress, Convert & Edit
categoryPages.description: Free online image tools — resize, compress, crop, remove backgrounds, convert WebP/HEIC/AVIF, and more. Processed locally in your browser.
categoryPages.intro: Upload images from your device and edit them instantly. No server uploads, no accounts — just fast, private image processing in your browser.

categoryPages.title: Free Video Tools Online — Compress, Trim, Convert to GIF or MP3
categoryPages.description: Free online video tools — compress, trim, crop, merge, convert to GIF or MP3, and more. Runs in your browser with no signup.
categoryPages.intro: Upload video files and convert or edit them locally. Heavy processing uses WebAssembly in your browser — nothing is sent to our servers.

categoryPages.title: Free Audio Tools Online — Trim, Convert, Merge & Record
categoryPages.description: Free online audio tools — trim, convert formats, merge tracks, adjust speed, transcribe speech, and more. No signup required.
categoryPages.intro: Upload or record audio and process it in your browser. Convert between MP3, WAV, OGG, and other formats without uploading to a server.

categoryPages.title: Free Developer Tools Online — JSON, JWT, Regex, Hash & Code Utilities
categoryPages.description: Free online developer tools — JSON formatter, JWT decoder, regex tester, hash generator, Base64, UUID, and 50+ more. Instant, no signup.
categoryPages.intro: Built for developers who need fast utilities without friction. Paste code or data and get results instantly in your browser.

categoryPages.title: Free Text Tools Online — Edit, Transform, Count & Analyze
categoryPages.description: Free online text tools — case converter, word counter, diff checker, lorem ipsum, slugify, and dozens more. No signup, runs in your browser.
categoryPages.intro: Paste or type text and transform it instantly. Every text tool runs locally — your content stays private on your device.

categoryPages.title: Free Security Tools Online — Hash, Encrypt, Password & Crypto Utilities
categoryPages.description: Free online security tools — SHA hash generator, AES encrypt, password generator, HMAC, ciphers, and more. Client-side, no signup.
